title: 第23章 温热的起伏第24章 大人在怀疑我
lines: 大衍朝对女子抛头露面没有律法上的限制，尤其是底层百姓人家，毕竟还需女子出来做活补贴家用。
而权贵家的女眷们大多出门有车，有仆从，不怎么露脸。
可这男女私会，若叫人知晓会不光彩，不论什么样的人家皆是如此。
但花灯节这日不同，本身花灯就有寄相思之意，许多有情男女借着节日的热闹，私下见一见，这种事既公开又私密。
公开是因为大家默认了这一行径，私密是因为不能叫人发现，私会仍需避着，一旦拿出来见光，那就是件可小可大的事情。
戴缨一侧头便看见了谢容。
他也看见了她，接着两只船身迅速错开。
戴缨有些不懂，不管谢容出于什么目的，既然选择了陆婉儿，为何被她瞧见时，眼中又闪过无措的愧疚，象是要解释，开了口却又不知说什么。
这让她不得不想到上一世，在纳她为妾后，他歇在她屋里。
他会搂着她，握着她的手，捏一捏她的指尖，然后将她的手放到胸口，去感受那处温热的起伏。
亦会极尽柔情地同她温存。
她从不怀疑谢容是否真心，是有的，有过真心。
那可是自小伴到大的情谊。
她想不通的是……想不通的是……
为何十年，整整十年，在她失了他们的孩子后，他不再看她一眼，不进她的院子一步，绝情到那样一种地步。
若是厌弃了，在她请求离开时，他又不放手。
最后，她的身体渐渐失了温度，他抱着她，近乎崩溃。
“缨娘，缨娘……”
戴缨回过神，发现陆溪儿正在叫她。
“怎么了？”
戴缨问道。
“我刚才好象看见陆婉儿了，只看见一个影儿。”
陆溪儿往窗外张望，“好象对面还坐了一人，象是个男……”
陆溪儿看向戴缨，压低声：“是你家那位表兄？”
戴缨笑着摇了摇头：“没看清。”
陆溪儿略带同情地看向戴缨：“那该是你的姻缘，却被陆婉儿抢了。”
戴缨淡淡回道：“若是我的姻缘，抢不走，能抢走的，也不牢靠。”
这时，小陆崇拉住戴缨，懵懂道：“什么是姻缘？”
陆溪儿噗嗤一笑：“姻缘就是给人当媳妇。”
小陆崇张了张眼，在戴缨面上看了又看，皱起稀疏的眉头，做下决定：“那姐姐给我爹爹当媳妇。”
戴缨正往嘴里送茶，一听这话，被茶水呛得猛咳，陆溪儿忙起身，走到戴缨身边，替她顺气。
等到好一些了，戴缨拭了拭眼角的泪星儿，心想着，若能得老夫人垂怜，指一门好亲，自然是再好不过，却也没想过给人当继母。
不及戴缨开口，陆溪儿却怕戴缨当了真，抢说道：“小孩子家家的懂什么，快别乱说了。”
以他们陆家的门第和盛荣，就算三叔续弦，也轮不上戴缨，怕她起了不该有的心思，反害了她。
content_en:
The Dayan Dynasty had no legal restrictions on women's public appearance, especially for the lower class families. After all, women still needed to work to support the family.
Most of the female relatives of powerful families have cars and servants when they go out, and they rarely show their faces.
But this private meeting between men and women would be disgraceful if anyone knew about it, no matter what kind of family it was.
But this day of the Lantern Festival is different. The lanterns themselves have the meaning of expressing love. Many lovers take advantage of the excitement of the festival to meet in private. This kind of thing is both public and private.
It's public because everyone agrees to this behavior, and it's private because no one can discover it. Private meetings still need to be avoided. Once it is brought out to the light, it will be a small or big matter.
Dai Ying turned her head and saw Xie Rong.
He saw her too, and then the two hulls quickly separated.
Dai Ying didn't understand. No matter what Xie Rong's purpose was, since she chose Lu Waner, why did she feel helpless guilt flash in her eyes when she saw him, as if she wanted to explain, but didn't know what to say when she opened her mouth.
This reminded her of her previous life, when he rested in her house after taking her as his concubine.
He would hug her, hold her hand, squeeze her fingertips, and then put her hand on her chest to feel the warm ups and downs there.
He will also treat her with utmost tenderness.
She never doubted whether Xie Rong was sincere, she was sincere.
That's the friendship we've had since childhood.
What she couldn't figure out was... what she couldn't figure out was...
Why ten years, a whole ten years, after she lost their child, he never looked at her again or took a step into her yard, so heartless.
If he was tired of her, he wouldn't let her go when she asked to leave.
Finally, her body gradually lost its temperature, and he almost collapsed while holding her.
"Ying Niang, Ying Niang..."
Dai Ying came to her senses and found that Lu Xi'er was calling her.
"What's wrong?"
Dai Ying asked.
"I seemed to have seen Lu Wan'er just now, but I only saw a shadow."
Lu Xi'er looked out the window, "There seems to be someone sitting opposite, a man..."
Lu Xi'er looked at Dai Ying and lowered her voice: "Is that your cousin?"
Dai Ying smiled and shook her head: "I didn't see clearly."
Lu Xi'er looked at Dai Ying with some sympathy: "That was supposed to be your marriage, but Lu Waner took it away from you."
Dai Ying replied calmly: "If it's my marriage, it can't be taken away. If it can be taken away, it's not reliable."
At this time, Xiao Lu Chong grabbed Dai Ying and asked confusedly: "What is marriage?"
Lu Xier chuckled: "Marriage is to be someone's wife."
Xiao Lu Chong opened his eyes, looked at Dai Ying's face again and again, frowned and made a decision: "Then sister will be my father's wife."
Dai Ying was putting tea into her mouth. When she heard this, she choked on the tea and coughed violently. Lu Xi'er quickly stood up and walked to Dai Ying's side to calm her down.
When she felt better, Dai Ying wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes, thinking that it would be great if she could get the old lady's pity and find a good match, but she never thought about being a stepmother.
Before Dai Ying could speak, Lu Xi'er was afraid that Dai Ying would take her seriously, so she said quickly, "What do children know? Stop talking nonsense."
With their Lu family's status and prosperity, even if the third uncle remarried, it would not be Dai Ying's turn. He was afraid that she would have inappropriate thoughts and harm her.
title_en: Chapter 23 The ups and downs of warmth Chapter 24 Sir, you are doubting me
